confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Positano's July high-season prices. No city-price web searches or live listings were consulted. Restaurant, beer, and coffee anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors are lower confidence because Positano has few hostels and room rates swing widely with season and availability. Cocktail and wine were estimated directly from local knowledge, not derived from the beer anchor. The FX value (0.6947 on 2026-10-16) comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange rates page; the page itself was not opened and verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a peak-season Amalfi Coast resort town, using Sorrento and Capri as the closest comparables for venue tiers. Restaurant and bar prices are set above typical inland southern Italian towns.
